title: Terraform KMS/HSM lifecycle operator for private deployments
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a Terraform-based lifecycle operator (module + orchestration patterns) for integrating KMS and HSM backends into Redwood Private deployments. The operator will provide idempotent provisioning, zero-downtime key rotation orchestration, IAM binding bootstrapping, and a safe path for migrating secrets between Secret Manager and Vault in air-gapped and VPC environments. This ticket covers the Terraform module design, integration tests, CI gates, and an upgrade strategy for existing on-prem clusters.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable Terraform module exposes a stable interface for KMS and HSM backends (cloud KMS, cloud-HSM, PKCS#11 adapter).
Module supports a rotation workflow that coordinates: key creation, new-key provisioning to services, staggered promotion, old-key deprecation, and rollback within configurable windows.
IAM/ACL/binding bootstrap implemented as optional sub-module to create least-privilege service identities and role bindings required for automated rotation.
Migration helper supports stable sync from AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager to Vault with verification and a dry-run mode.
End-to-end tests run in CI that validate provisioning, rotation, and migration against a test HSM emulator and a Vault test cluster.
Module has clear upgrade notes and a zero-downtime upgrade playbook for private clusters in Confluence.
Security review completed and KMS/HSM audit logging integrated with customer audit streams for Private deployments.
implementation_notes: Pattern: module exposes provider-agnostic 'kms_backend' block. Internally uses provider mapping to aws_kms, google_kms, or pkcs11 provider for HSM appliances.
Rotation: implement as a stateful resource 'redwood_kms_rotation' which tracks rotation phases using Terraform 'time_sleep' and remote state locks to coordinate across instances.
DRIFT: add optional Terraform Cloud run with pre-apply checks and drift-detection webhook to trigger reconciles when external key material changes.

Secrets migration: two-phase approach — (1) shadow-sync new secrets into Vault with metadata and checksum; (2) cutover by updating service bindings to read from Vault. Support 'read-through' for a configurable transition window.
IAM: sub-module creates service principals/service accounts and minimum IAM policies, emits binding outputs for downstream modules to consume.
HSM connectivity: support PKCS#11 via a small sidecar daemon on the private control plane that proxies requests to on-prem HSMs; Terraform module will configure the sidecar and TLS credentials.
Testing: use SoftHSM for CI and a lightweight Vault dev cluster with auto-unseal using a test KMS key. Add acceptance tests that run in ephemeral clusters on our integration fleet.
progress_updates: 2026-01-20: Kickoff meeting with Infra, Security, and PM to align constraints for air-gapped environments — agreed on PKCS#11 adapter pattern and mandatory audit logging.
2026-01-28: Initial module scaffold committed (repo: infra/modules/kms-lifecycle). Created primary input/output schema and provider mapping logic.
2026-02-12: Prototype rotation controller implemented as a wrapper script; validated mechanics against SoftHSM in local integration test; observed edge-case when service caches KV IDs.
2026-02-20: Design review with Security — added requirement for HSM attestation checks and audit-forwarding. Security requested mandatory security_review flag for any production deploy.
2026-02-27: Began work on migration helper; implemented shadow-sync with checksum verification. Dry-run mode passes for small secret set.
2026-03-05: Created Confluence upgrade playbook draft and runbook for operator rollback. Added canary rollout plan for rotation (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
2026-03-10: Opened PR #4872 for module initial implementation and unit tests. CI failing on intermittent SoftHSM binding; investigating race in sidecar startup.
decisions: Use a provider-agnostic interface in the Terraform module to avoid requiring separate modules per cloud — decided for maintainability and consistent UX.

Rotation orchestrator is implemented outside pure Terraform (small controller script invoked by CI) because Terraform lacks built-in multi-step coordination primitives for staged promotion with service-side validation.
Choose to support Vault as primary secrets store for Private deployments post-migration; Secret Manager remains supported as source for migration.
review_feedback: Security: require KMS key aliasing + HSM key attestation before promotion to 'active'. Add audit trail export to customer log sinks.
Platform: prefer 'outputs' that expose only minimal ARNs/IDs — avoid embedding secrets into module outputs.
SRE: add health-check endpoints on the sidecar proxy and expose a Terraform-managed Kubernetes liveness probe manifest.
follow_ups: Implement attestation check integration with onboarding scripts (ENG-35120).
Add automated smoke tests in our infra-e2e pipeline post-merge (ENG-35205).
Coordinate enterprise customer migration pilot and schedule maintenance window (PM to own customer comms).
testing_plan: Unit: terraform validate + tfsec for all module changes in PRs.
Integration: ephemeral infra stack in CI using SoftHSM and dev Vault; run full rotation and migration scenarios.
Canary: deploy to a single private cluster with a non-critical tenant and exercise rotation at 10% traffic before broader rollout.
Security: run Secrets Red-Team checklist and threat model review as part of pre-release gating.
